2607.03659.title: A Fair Benchmarking of Deep Relational Database Learning Models
2607.03659.paper_summary: Relational databases (RDBs) are the primary data infrastructure in many enterprises, yet recent deep learning methods designed for RDBs have been evaluated under inconsistent experimental protocols, making fair comparison difficult. We present one of the first systematic benchmarking studies of recently released deep learning methods for RDBs, evaluating them across five relational databases, with one classification and one regression task for each. We refactor all deep RDB models to allow the full range of experimental procedures to be applied consistently across all methods. Our findings indicate that the relational transformer (RT) approach delivers the strongest overall performance on both classification and regression tasks compared to the state-of-the-art graph-based modeling and learning of RDBs. Even for single-table learning tasks, deep learning methods designed for RDBs outperform the leading tabular foundation model, TabPFN 2.5. Extending learning from a single table (hop = 0) to multiple tables (hop = 1, 2) by connecting neighboring tables in relational databases enhances performance, but the additional benefit from higher hops diminishes as computational overhead grows. Deep RDB learning methods have the potential to challenge state-of-the-art tabular foundation models, especially on large-scale enterprise data. The source code for this benchmarking study is publicly available.
2607.03659.paper_summary_zh: 關聯式資料庫（RDBs）是許多企業的主要資料基礎設施，但最近針對 RDBs 設計的深度學習方法在不一致的實驗協議下進行評估，這使得公平比較變得困難。<lb/>我們呈現了針對最近發布的 RDBs 深度學習方法的首個系統性基準研究之一，對五個關聯式資料庫進行評估，每個資料庫有一個分類任務和一個回歸任務。<lb/>我們重構了所有深度 RDB 模型，以便在所有方法中一致地應用全範圍的實驗程序。<lb/>我們的發現表明，關聯式Transformer（RT）方法在分類和回歸任務上相比於最先進的基於圖的 RDB 建模和學習方法，提供了最強的整體性能。<lb/>即使在單表學習任務中，針對 RDBs 設計的深度學習方法也超越了領先的表格基礎模型 TabPFN 2.5。<lb/>通過在關聯式資料庫中連接相鄰的表，將單表學習（hop = 0）擴展到多表（hop = 1, 2）可以提升性能，但隨著計算開銷的增加，來自更高 hops 的額外好處會減少。<lb/>深度 RDB 學習方法有潛力挑戰最先進的表格基礎模型，特別是在大規模企業數據上。<lb/>本基準研究的源代碼已公開可用。
